title: ¡Rojito cambia de color! 🚒🌈 | Aprende los Colores #Shorts
world: toy paint playground: a play road with big pools of blue, yellow, green and red paint + a meadow with a big rainbow
story: Rojito drives into a blue paint pool, SPLASH, he turns blue! (surprise problem)
Blue Rojito? He blinks at himself (reaction)
Yellow paint pool: now he is yellow! (repeat 1)
Green paint pool: now he is green! (repeat 2)
Red paint pool: he is red again! (fix)
He drives under a big rainbow, happy (reward)
A purple drop falls on his roof, uy! (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Splash! ¡Rojito azul!
[Verse]
¡Azul, azul! ¿Quién es?
¡Splash! ¡Amarillo!
¡Splash! ¡Verde, verde!
[Chorus]
¡No, no! ¿Dónde está Rojito?
¡Rojo, rojo! ¡Aquí está!
¡Arcoíris, a rodar!
[Outro]
¡Uy! ¿Morado?

locations.pintura: A cheerful toy paint playground, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a smooth white play road with four big round shallow pools of thick paint in a row, bright blue, sunny yellow, grass green and cherry red, colorful paint splashes on the road edges, soft rounded green hills and a blue sky with white clouds. No vehicles on the road.
locations.arcoiris: A sunny meadow with a road, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a smooth sandy road curving through soft green grass with little flowers, a big bright rainbow arching across the blue sky, fluffy white clouds. No vehicles on the road.

shots: Low side view at ground level: the little red fire truck character drives from left to right into a big round pool of bright blue paint, a huge splash of blue paint flying up in the air around him.
He drives into the blue pool, a big blue splash flies up.

Close-up from the front: the little fire truck character is now completely BRIGHT BLUE all over, his whole body, cab and doors painted blue, blue paint dripping from his ladder and bumper, his big eyes looking down at himself in surprise.
Blue paint drips down from his ladder, he blinks in surprise.

View from behind and above: the completely blue little fire truck character drives out of a big pool of sunny yellow paint, yellow paint splashing high, the back half of the truck already turning sunny yellow.
He splashes through the yellow pool, yellow paint flies.

Close-up three-quarter view: the little fire truck character is now completely SUNNY YELLOW all over, his whole body painted yellow, standing in a pool of grass-green paint, green paint splashing up onto his yellow doors, he laughs.
Green paint splashes up onto him and he laughs.

Front view: the little fire truck character is now completely GRASS GREEN all over, his whole body painted green, looking worried at his reflection in a shiny puddle, a little question mark sparkle above his ladder.
He looks at his green reflection and tilts his cab, worried.

Low side view: the green little fire truck character plunges into a big pool of cherry-red paint, a giant red splash flying up, and he comes out shiny cherry red again with a huge happy smile, sparkles around him.
A giant red splash flies up and he comes out red and happy, sparkles twinkle.
Wide shot of the sunny meadow: the shiny red little fire truck character drives along the curving sandy road under a big bright rainbow, happy, little flowers on both sides.
He drives happily along the road under the rainbow.

Top-down close view from above the little red fire truck's roof: one big purple paint drop falls from the sky and lands on his roof next to the blue siren with a splat, he looks up with a funny surprised face.
A purple drop falls and splats on his roof, he looks up surprised.

hero.who: The little red fire truck character
hero.one: Only one vehicle character in the picture.

style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: ROJITO, a cute little red toy fire truck character with a friendly face: a short chubby rounded body like a toddler toy, shiny cherry-red paint, a big curved windshield with two big glossy dark-brown cartoon eyes with white sparkle highlights and expressive eyebrows, a small smiling mouth on the front bumper, rosy pink cheeks on the front, a small white ladder on the roof, one round blue siren light on top, a golden bell on the front, a small number 1 in a yellow circle on each door.
twist: each splash hides the new color until the paint drips off — the viewer guesses first; the last pool (red) gives Rojito back himself
moral: ¡Azul, amarillo o verde… Rojito sigue siendo Rojito!
experiment: interactive guess-the-color structure (TikiTykes 20.1M x1171) — first guessing video on the channel
continuity: color state: red (C1) -> blue (C2) -> yellow (C3-C4) -> green (C4-C5) -> red (C6-C8); purple drop only in C8; siren always blue
